label: PF Backlog 225
title: Backend: product one-stop read-model API (identity, lifecycle, progress, features, artifacts, quality, cost, BOM, links)
body:
## Problem / why
The dashboard page needs one aggregate payload built by DERIVING from existing stores - not a new store,
and not N client-side joins.

## Goal & value
A read-model API that composes the one-stop page from existing truth (no duplication).

## In scope (endpoints)
- `/products/<id>` (identity+lifecycle+links) · `/progress` · `/features` (backlog project scope)
  `/artifacts` (stage_paths/assets) · `/quality` (run_quality_gate + compliance + evals)
  `/cost` (budget + per-unit media) · `/bom` (BI-0217) · `/releases` · `/activity` (events/approvals/history).
- Role-aware fields (builder vs owner); pagination; caching.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- One call returns the page state for a given project; every field traces to a named source of truth.
- A text-only project returns a valid payload with empty media sections.

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: each endpoint against fixtures; contract test that fields map to the documented sources.
